reason: I have one or two chairs and I am standing at one of them myself, so I already see who is in which chair and what is in the drawer. WhatsApp and my notebook do the job, and ₹999 every month plus ₹4,999 is real money for a shop my size.
objection: If the app stops working on a busy Sunday with customers waiting, who do I call? I can't stop cutting to sort out a phone problem, and I don't want my one stylist fumbling with selfies and English screens.
would_change_my_mind: A local person I can call or WhatsApp who actually picks up on Sundays, no setup fee, and proof from another small barber near me that the reminders and wallet brought regulars back more often.
